subject: ela
intro: Read each short story and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

Leo has a pet turtle named Shell.

What is the turtle's name?
A) Leo
B) Shell
C) Pet

steps: The story says the turtle is named Shell. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The little bird could not fly yet, so its mom brought it food.

items.answer: B) The bird could not fly yet

steps: The story gives the reason. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) The bird could not fly yet
